items.title: Populate AuditConfig.parallelGate in resolveAuditConfig: per-profile defaults + a resolveParallelGate(raw, profileDefault) helper validating the nested object field-by-field (mode/maxConcurrentReview/broadGlobBlocks) with guards and fallbacks per spec 4.7
